trial_court: Family Court, Udaipur, Gomati District, Tripura in Title Suit (Divorce) 91 of 2019
case_name: Shri Jitun Datta vs Smt. Rakhi Sukladas (Datta)
facts_of_case: The husband filed a petition for divorce under Section 13(1)(i) and Section 13(1)(ib) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 on grounds of voluntary sexual intercourse with any person other than her spouse and desertion. The wife contested the case by submitting a written statement. Evidences were taken up after framing of issues and both parties introduced witnesses before the learned trial Court.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking divorce to prove desertion.
legal_principles.held: It is contended on behalf of the appellant that the respondent wilfully deserted the appellant on 29.09.2019 from the rented house...

legal_principles.principle: The court will not grant divorce based on desertion unless the party seeking divorce proves wilful desertion.
legal_principles.held: It is seen from record that the appellant herein preferred a suit for dissolution of marriage under Section 13(1)(i) and 13(1)(ib) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955...

outcome.final_order: The application filed by the appellant for grant of decree of divorce was dismissed by the impugned Judgment and decree dated 27.09.2024 passed in T.S. (Div.) 91 of 2019.
